II.  Frozen fish for sale at the fish market should be placed in a room or cabinet below 2 ° C as soon as possible.
In all cases, fish should be protected from spoilage and combustion.
Fresh fish for display at temperatures above 2 degrees Celsius at a fish market should not be sold or refilled for
any reason in refrigerated or refrigerated air conditioned premises.
Fish  placed  in  exhibit  refrigerators  in  a  fish  market  should  not  be  resold  for  any  reason,  either  favorable  or
harmful, or in refrigerated or air conditioned premises.
A licensed fish market must be kept free of dogs, cats, rats, or any other animal.
